body:
I was diagnosed with SAD (social anxiety disorder) a few months ago and was given Paxil to take along with some Xanax. I was to take 25mg of Paxil one time a day and .25mg 3 times a day of Xanax. The Xanax was meant to last just long enough for it to keep me calm until the Paxil kicked in. Paxil doesnt work imediately. I was worried about the side effects of this drug. I read a lot of bad things about withdraw symptoms which really freaked me out. But Paxil had changed my life for the better, aside from the loss of libido for a while. I have been able to eat a lot more, which is great as I am underweight. I love to eat now. I feel better and  happier. I am a little more outgoing, but not as much as I was when I was on Xanax.
The Xanax kicked ass and I tried different amounts all the way up to 2mg. But before I knew it I had run out. Thats when I turned to my backup stash of propranolol which is meant to slow down your heart rate. It is great for speeches where you have to talk in front of a lot of people. However, I liked the Xanax a lot better. Oh well. I was also given some Promethazine when I was sick and throwing up a lot. It is supposed to prevent nausea and is also given as a sleeping aide. This shit will knock me out. Anything over 50mg will knock me out quick. I take a few along with some Propranolol before bed sometimes. This really chills me out. I also smoke weed. Every day for the past 2 years I have smoked. I love it. It enhances any drug I have ever taken. It just adds to the chill factor of any drug.
Taking LSD on Paxil sucks ass. Every time I eat some it makes the back of my head hurt and my right ear hurts and feels like the music isnt hitting my ear in the right direction, so I also am turning my head. It is hard to describe. Also, no matter how much I eat, the trip is never that hard, just mild visuals. I am pissed bout this cuz I love L and I ate it a few times before I was on Paxil and loved it. Now I stay away from it. I also cant try DXM while using Paxil, dammit. I wanted to try that. Oh well.
